metadata.name: Speedup - Game Speed Control
metadata.description:
Make the whole game run faster: you, enemies, tears, projectiles and timers all speed up together, so the game plays exactly the same, just shorter. Pure Lua, no external tools needed. Requires Repentance or Repentance+ (not Afterbirth+).
[b]Speed rules[/b] - Cleared room (exploring, shops, treasure rooms): x1.30 by default. Rooms that still have traps (spike blocks, stone shooters, red or purple fires, troll bombs, on/off spikes...) or new enemies (spiders from a pot...) use the Combat speed instead. - Boss fight (boss, miniboss, Boss Rush, and any room while a boss is alive, like boss challenge rooms): x1.20 by default - Combat (everything else): x1.20 by default - Optional [b]Learn per room[/b] (off by default): every room layout remembers its own speed across runs, +0.05 each time you clear it without getting hit, -0.10 when you get hit.
[b]How to adjust[/b] - Press [b][noparse]\[/noparse][/b] in game to open the Speedup panel: Up/Down select, Left/Right adjust (hold to keep changing; step 0.05, range x1.00 ~ x3.00), Esc or [b][noparse]\[/noparse][/b] to close. Shooting is paused while it is open; you can still walk. - Quick keys: [b][noparse]][/noparse][/b] / [b][noparse][[/noparse][/b] speed up / slow down the rule active right now. - Also available in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2681875787]Mod Config Menu Pure[/url] if installed (optional). - Faster music / sound effects can be turned on in the panel (off by default; faster audio also means higher pitch). - A [b]Real time clock[/b] next to the minimap shows how long the run really took (pauses excluded, kept when you exit and continue). Can be turned off in the panel. - Settings are saved.
Note: the in-game clock counts game time, so Boss Rush / Hush time limits still apply, just in sped-up time. Room transitions are not sped up.
[b]Active Cam[/b] makes the camera wobble in big rooms while sped up, so the mod turns it off once, on your first run with it (with a message). You can turn it back on in Options and it stays on.
